newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER - BELGIUM SACK COACH VAN MOER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - BELGIUM SACK COACH VAN MOER.

text.p: Belgium soccer coach Wilfried Van Moer has been sacked after nine months in charge and replaced by Georges Leekens, coach of surprise first division leaders Mouscron, a soccer union spokesman said on Tuesday.
"Confirmed," spokesman Guido Dewindt said when asked to comment on a report in Het Volk newspaper.
He said Van Moer was sacked because of Belgium's humiliating 3-0 home defeat by the Netherlands in a World Cup qualifier last month and because of communication problems with players and the media.
Belgium, bidding to qualify for their fifth consecutive World Cup finals, are third in European qualifying group seven, behind the Netherlands and Wales.
They won their first two matches, against Turkey and San Marino, before losing to the Dutch.
